seo.title: Atul Pandey — Senior Software Engineer | React Native & Full-Stack Mobile
seo.description: Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years building offline-first, cloud-connected enterprise mobile applications used by 5,000+ technicians globally.

hero.subheading: Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years delivering enterprise mobile applications for 5,000+ global users. Skilled in React Native, offline-first architecture, AWS cloud services, and full-stack mobile development. Based in Hyderabad, India.

about.heading: Engineering mobile systems that work everywhere, always.
paragraphs: I build enterprise mobile applications that don't break when the internet does. My focus is on offline-first architectures, cloud-connected systems, and scalable mobile solutions that serve field technicians in environments where reliability isn't optional — it's the product.

At Innovapptive, I lead development of React Native enterprise apps used daily by 5,000+ technicians, architect backend integrations with Node.js and GraphQL, and drive performance optimizations that deliver 60% faster load times and 2.5× faster data synchronization in low-connectivity industrial environments.

experience.subtitle: Offline-First Mobile Applications
highlights: Lead development of React Native enterprise mobile apps using Redux Toolkit, REST/GraphQL APIs, AWS (S3, Lambda, API Gateway), Firebase, and BLE integration for 5,000+ global field technicians
Architect scalable mobile and backend integration layers using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and GraphQL, reducing production defects
Drive performance optimization improving offline sync reliability and reducing load times by 60% in low-connectivity environments
Mentor engineering team on React Native, Android, iOS, Next.js, and enterprise mobile architecture best practices
Collaborate across product, QA, backend, and DevOps teams in Agile/Scrum environments
Enhance CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and automated testing workflows improving deployment stability

experience.subtitle: AI & Cloud-Connected SaaS Systems
highlights: Built AI-powered enterprise solutions using OpenAI, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Neo4j, GraphQL, and AWS → 47% faster issue resolution
Developed RAG-based assistants, OCR/ML pipelines, and intelligent automation using vector embeddings and TensorFlow Lite
Designed cloud-connected synchronization solutions improving operational reliability and data availability for enterprise mobile users

experience.subtitle: Mobile Applications
highlights: Developed React Native and Android applications using TypeScript, Kotlin, Firebase, REST APIs, and offline sync for enterprise users
Integrated cloud services, analytics, and production monitoring using Firebase and AWS, improving app stability
Delivered mobile features, performance optimizations, and production releases across enterprise React Native applications

items.title: Construction Project Management Suite
items.problem: Construction teams across 100+ sites had no unified platform for real-time task coordination and workflow tracking.
items.solution: Designed and built a multi-platform construction project automation system supporting task allocation, workflow tracking, and real-time progress insights with bidirectional mobile-to-web sync.
items.impact: 45% improvement in on-site collaboration, 30% reduction in operational delays. Role-based access and analytics dashboards serving 100+ field technicians.

items.title: Real-Time Offline Sync (R&D)
items.problem: Field technicians lost data and productivity in areas with no internet, and existing sync solutions couldn't handle dense industrial facilities.
items.solution: Engineered a conflict-free, peer-to-peer multi-node sync network using Ditto SDK and Realm with edge-driven event queues achieving zero-downtime data reliability.
items.impact: 2.5× faster data propagation vs Firebase-only architectures. 70% fewer sync failures in dense facilities like oil refineries and power plants.

items.title: AI-Powered Root Cause Analysis Engine
items.problem: Enterprise technicians spent hours manually diagnosing equipment failures with no intelligent assistance.
items.solution: Built an LLM-powered RCA prototype within 48 hours using OpenAI, Neo4j knowledge graph, and RAG pipelines, later adopted into production.
items.impact: 47% faster resolution time. Used by 5,000+ technicians daily. Won 1st Place at Gen AI Hackathon 2025.
